title: 第3章 天地异象第4章 主线任务
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
时间过得很快。
于修仙者而言，十个月不过弹指一挥。
或许是因为身体缩小的缘故，所以朔衡每天都要花费很长的时间睡觉。
听004说，这是因为身体还在发育导致的正常状态，让他不必担心。
朔衡也确实没担心。
他整天就在意识空间里看资料，看外面老妈老爹在外面干啥，然后休眠。
小日子过得不可谓不舒坦。
甚至就当他即将出生的前几天把资料全部看完之后，004怕他待的无聊，还特意给他找了几个其他世界的影视作品来看。
朔衡现在也算大致了解了这些系统的权限和作用，包括主系统管辖之下的以亿为单位计数的大世界。
其中的文化作品更是多如繁星，朔衡看得津津有味。
【宿主，您要出生了。】
朔衡从电视剧里回过神。
【这么快就到日子了？也好。】
朔衡笑了笑。
对于修仙世界的生活，他很期待。
——
晏情在吃完今日份的灵药药膳过后，感受到了即将生产的征兆。
猛然握住一旁朔涯的大手，眼中的些许慌乱看得朔涯很是心疼。
无论晏情本人是个多么强大的修仙者，如今都是要第一次当母亲，朔涯十分理解自家夫人的慌张。
别说晏情了，连他自己都紧张的手心冒汗。

“来人！夫人胎动了！”
朔涯握紧晏情的手，给予她坚定的安抚：“夫人，没事的，你和孩子都会平平安安。”
晏情已经感受到腹部剧烈的绞痛了，她忍着痛对朔涯微笑着点点头，而后被人扶进了产房里。
产房外，甚是热闹。
不止是朔涯在焦急等候，连九祖朔古也来了，此刻正坐在一旁的椅子上喝茶。
除了这两位，还有另一个男人带着一个小孩从远处飞来。
男人脚下踏着一朵洁白的祥云，落地后消失不见。
“九祖，大哥。”
朔阳，朔涯同父异母的亲弟弟。
之前因为晏情怀孕期间不愿见客，所以朔阳也就没来打扰，但他心中还是十分惦念自己的嫂子和未出生的侄儿，所以各种天材地宝是源源不断的送进大哥的库房里。
“二弟和小夜来了，坐吧。”
content_en:
Time flies.
For a cultivator, ten months is just a snap of the fingers.
Perhaps because of his shrinking body, Shuo Heng spent a long time sleeping every day.
According to 004, this is a normal state because the body is still growing, so he doesn't need to worry.
Shuo Heng was indeed not worried.
He spends the whole day reading information in his conscious space, watching what mom and dad are doing outside, and then goes to sleep.
It can be said that my little life was uncomfortable.
Even after reading all the information a few days before he was about to be born, 004 was afraid that he would be bored, so he specially found some film and television works from other worlds for him to watch.
Shuo Heng now has a general understanding of the permissions and functions of these systems, including the big world that is counted in hundreds of millions under the jurisdiction of the main system.
There were as many cultural works as stars, and Shuoheng looked at them with gusto.
[Host, you are about to be born. 】
Shuo Heng came back to his senses from the TV series.
[The day is coming so soon? That's fine. 】
Shuo Heng smiled.
He is looking forward to life in the world of cultivating immortals.
——
After Yan Qing finished today's portion of the elixir, she felt the signs that she was about to give birth.
Suddenly he held Shuo Ya's big hand on the side, and the slight panic in his eyes made Shuo Ya feel very distressed.
No matter how powerful an immortal cultivator Yan Qing is, she is now about to become a mother for the first time. Shuo Ya understands his wife's panic very well.
Not to mention Yan Qing, even he himself was nervous and his palms were sweating.
"Come here! Madam's fetus is moving!"
Shuo Ya held Yan Qing's hand tightly and gave her firm comfort: "Madam, it's okay. You and the child will be safe."
Yan Qing could already feel the severe cramping pain in her abdomen. She endured the pain and smiled at Shuo Ya, nodded, and then was helped into the delivery room.
Outside the delivery room, it was very lively.
Not only Shuo Ya was waiting anxiously, but Shuo Gu, the ninth ancestor, was also here and was sitting on a chair nearby drinking tea.
In addition to these two people, there was another man flying in from a distance with a child.
A white auspicious cloud stood under the man's feet and disappeared after landing.
"Ninth Ancestor, eldest brother."
Shuoyang, Shuoya's half-brother.
Because Yan Qing didn't want to see guests during her pregnancy, Shuoyang didn't bother her. However, he still missed his sister-in-law and unborn nephew very much, so all kinds of natural and earthly treasures were continuously sent to his eldest brother's warehouse.
"Second brother and Xiaoye are here, sit down."
